quality_rules.full: metadata.json parses; frame_id matches folder and index; 3 originals present and decode to 480x640 uint8; pixel sha256 == metadata original_pixels sha256; file sha256 == metadata sha256; export manifest sha256 matches for every exported file in the frame; frames.csv row exists and speeds/ages/grabbed/skew all match metadata; timestamps finite
quality_rules.fresh: full AND max(age_left_ms, age_front_ms, age_right_ms) <= 200 ms (production control freshness limit (max of three ages); ps/car_loop.py:61 max_age_s=0.2 (default), applied to max(age_left_ms, age_front_ms, age_right_ms) at ps/car_loop.py:143)
quality_rules.primary: sample belongs to primary_run (latest run_* by name)
quality_rules.index_valid: index.jsonl frame record present and every shipped file hash passes the index sha map
quality_rules.recovered: no index record, but metadata + 3 originals + pixel/file sha are complete; index is NOT modified
quality_rules.usable: full AND fresh; model predictions/speeds are never used to select samples
quality_rules.skew: host_frame_skew_ms > 100 ms is a diagnostic heuristic only (no production threshold found; 100 ms is an audit-only heuristic); it never removes a sample from usable/primary selection
quality_rules.duplicate_note: duplicate pixel sha across frames is reported as evidence only; a static or reused image is not by itself an error and no sample is deleted for it
